subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should unconfigured Feishu group text commands be allowed by default when access groups are enabled, or should group command execution require an explicit allowFrom/owner policy?
rationale: Current source and latest release reproduce the denial path, and the implicated shared gate was introduced as slash/control command security hardening, so automation cannot safely choose the default group-command security posture.

options.title: Allow unconfigured group commands
options.body: Treat no configured command authorizer as open for Feishu group text commands and cover it with allowlist regression tests.

options.title: Require explicit allowlist
options.body: Keep fail-closed group command authorization and update Feishu setup/docs/diagnostics so users know how to configure allowed command senders.

recommendation.title: Allow unconfigured group commands
recommendation.body: Treat no configured command authorizer as open for Feishu group text commands and cover it with allowlist regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored both the original shared command-gating security fix and a later gating refactor, making them the best available policy owner from history.
